data.body: Post-pause long-tail audit: run 31834896849 (the reported 57m failure) is now explicitly decomposed as 25m13s same-change admission delay behind run 31834162663 plus 30m23s macOS execution and normal routing/vote overhead. Gerrit metadata proves both were change 1788 PS1 runs; the replacement clear job started three seconds after the predecessor final cast completed. Closed ticket esthetic-degrading-pupa / merged 4cbaa19315 fixed the cancellation mechanism by replacing always() with !cancelled() on seven full-route jobs while retaining classifier-failure fallback. Organic change 1790 replacements reduced stale-run shutdown/admission to 78s and 110s. Current-main run 31883105646 had 2-3s job queues, max concurrency 13, and 60m48s successful-job occupancy. No newer organic Verify sample existed at 2026-08-15T12:27Z; average completion remains intentionally unclosed pending additional current-main runs.
